topics.name: Digital twins for industrial maintenance
topics.summary: Across industrial maintenance studies, digital-twin architectures, remaining-life value estimates, evidence-grounded agents, and physically checkable fault features recur; distributed monitoring becomes more useful when diagnosis and explanations remain auditable.

topics.name: Decentralized multi-agent reinforcement learning
topics.summary: These papers use consensus or value learning, deep reinforcement learning, assignment search, and projected visual communication for aerial coverage, dispatch, and bimanual tasks; sparse communication and coordination-aware exploration improve efficiency but expose shared-resource conflicts.

topics.name: Robot navigation and safe motion planning
topics.summary: Learned controllers combine trajectory priors, stochastic optimal control, predictive constraints, and conformal tightening for robots operating with partial observations or uncertain dynamics; explicit risk margins improve completion under changing conditions.

topics.name: Contact-rich robot manipulation and compliant control
topics.summary: Manipulation systems pair null-space and task-space optimization, impedance regulation, tactile withdrawal, origami actuation, and visuo-tactile prediction across bimanual, shipboard, contact-rich, and medical-robot settings; compliance and contact modeling improve safety and transfer.

topics.name: Action-conditioned world models for robotics
topics.summary: Action-conditioned dynamics are tested with consistency contracts, identifiability analysis, robot rendering, and ultrasound guidance; separating embodiment from predictive state helps planning and reuse across robotic platforms.

topics.name: Geospatial and 3D environmental mapping
topics.summary: Aerial imagery, radar-camera depth, laser scans, scene graphs, stratigraphic logs, roofs, and soil samples are modeled with prompt refinement, transformers, graph attention, and geometric supervision; spatial structure improves mapping while sparse coverage limits transfer.

topics.name: Graph representation learning for structured networks
topics.summary: Heterophily-aware reconstruction, manifold alignment, curvature-based graph networks, graph optimization, neurograph analysis, and network anomaly structure recur across temporal knowledge, security, brain, and environmental graphs; preserving local and global relations improves robustness.

topics.name: Interactive visual analytics and data exploration
topics.summary: LLM-authored node graphs, latent-space flow views, tangible migration maps, and SQL-queryable self-organizing maps support exploratory analysis; linking representations to domain evidence helps users compare clusters, routes, and evolving hypotheses.

topics.name: Security and information-flow control for LLM agents
topics.summary: Agent threat studies examine contagion in multi-agent networks, web-RAG manipulation, capability scoping, permission architectures, information omission, and disclosure limits; propagation tracing and least-privilege controls reduce unsafe downstream actions.

topics.name: AI safety governance and explainable sequential control
topics.summary: Lifecycle governance, certified runtime checks, curvature-based safety defenses, deployment mediation, and interpretable collision or air-traffic decisions recur; the studies favor explicit threat models, monitoring, rollback, and human-readable evidence for high-impact systems.

topics.name: Efficient long-context language-model inference
topics.summary: Sparse attention, coordinated weight-activation pruning, conditional compute skipping, hierarchical key-value caching, CPU-GPU scheduling, and block-denoising language models reduce memory traffic; benchmarks report better throughput or latency with bounded quality loss.

topics.name: Neural operators and physics-informed scientific learning
topics.summary: Neural operators, manifold-aware gradients, latent PDE maps, multiphase-flow benchmarks, and physics-guided fluid representations are evaluated across boundary conditions and sensing regimes; embedding geometry and physical structure improve transfer with limited data.

topics.name: Latent reasoning and model interpretability
topics.summary: Logical structures, latent reasoning states, denoised traces, indexing analyses, temporal neuro-symbolic tests, attention rollouts, mass-aware attention, and spatial probes inspect hidden computation; output quality can coexist with incomplete or misleading reasoning traces.

topics.name: Evidence-grounded generation and retrieval
topics.summary: Retrieval, document reconstruction, turn-level factual checks, and agentic evidence integration recur in historical archives, document-based audio, and enterprise workflows; grounding and revision improve support, though source selection and context gaps remain failure points.

topics.name: Multimodal visual reasoning
topics.summary: Visual evidence extraction, saliency distillation, multi-agent debate, prototype guidance, and confidence probing are applied to physics figures, harmful memes, and degraded images; explicit visual cues improve reasoning while internal confidence is not always verbalized.

topics.name: AI-generated content forensics
topics.summary: Statistical watermark tests, wavelet token signals, camera-process camouflage, adapter diagnostics, conditional sensitivity, and semantic or high-pass forensic features span text, speech, and images; robustness depends on cross-domain calibration and realistic transformations.

topics.name: Embodied navigation datasets and evaluation
topics.summary: New navigation resources record multicultural human-robot interactions, aerial mission behavior, and outdoor vision-language movement; evaluation emphasizes long-horizon planning, embodiment, and reporting rather than isolated perception scores.

topics.name: Clinical multimodal understanding and evidence verification
topics.summary: Clinical report generation, image comprehension checklists, radiology grounding, 3D-CT probes, EHR consistency checks, and option-wise medical retrieval use multimodal encoders and structured evidence; fine-grained grounding helps, but context errors persist.

topics.name: Reinforcement learning for LLM post-training
topics.summary: Rollout allocation, execution feedback, entropy-aware policy updates, and meta-skill curricula improve language-model reasoning; adaptive computation and restrained updates reduce task interference while preserving useful exploration.

topics.name: Clinical forecasting and decision support
topics.summary: Hypergraph forecasting restores temporal synchrony under missingness, while patient-aware pretraining, autism assessment, and dysphagia stacking model clinical context; sparse-record fusion helps prediction but decision support still requires clinician-centered evaluation.

topics.name: Parameter-efficient foundation-model adaptation
topics.summary: Low-rank updates are allocated by layer, topology, condition number, or expert routing, while tokenizer-aware distillation, data-mixture search, logit shifts, and embedding transforms provide lightweight control; these methods reduce adaptation cost with targeted capability retention.

topics.name: Multilingual speech and audio modeling
topics.summary: Projector reuse, cross-lingual augmentation, vocalization embeddings, and language normalization support multilingual recognition, speech synthesis, and audio representation learning; transfer improves when phonetic or language structure is made explicit.

topics.name: Multimodal representation pretraining for scientific sensing
topics.summary: Native multimodal pretraining, hyperspherical visual codes, ultrasound self-supervision, and lunar shared embeddings combine images with scientific measurements; few-shot mapping and regression benefit from geometry-aware representations, though modality scale remains important.

topics.name: Medical image segmentation and anatomical labeling
topics.summary: Medical inpainting, weak-boundary regularization, anatomy-lesion labels, angiography benchmarks, CT localization, thresholded contours, interactive prompts, active sampling, and adaptive decoders target reliable masks; boundary quality and annotation efficiency recur across clinical datasets.

topics.name: Domain-specialized multimodal language models
topics.summary: Fine-tuning and retrieval are compared for reactor licensing, driving behavior, and remote-sensing scenarios; staged capability building and domain evidence improve specialized multimodal outputs, while general fluency alone does not ensure operational reliability.

topics.name: Visual biometric recognition
topics.summary: Vehicle and cow recognition benchmarks vary pose, occlusion, identity similarity, and capture conditions; pretrained visual backbones and realistic protocols expose generalization gaps hidden by curated human-focused datasets.

topics.name: Continual learning under class and task expansion
topics.summary: Class-incremental vision, continual entity recognition, analytic long-tailed updates, and biologically inspired reinforcement learning use expert routing, compositional features, or spectral corrections; retaining prior knowledge while absorbing new categories remains difficult.

topics.name: Anomaly detection and imbalanced recognition
topics.summary: One-class audio and visual detectors, long-tail logit correction, anomaly metrics, FPGA deployment, and network micro-segmentation address scarce positives and skewed prevalence; memory or margin-based normality helps, but comparisons remain sensitive to class proportions and hardware.

topics.name: Domain generalization and fair representation learning
topics.summary: Projection-based domain generalization, fair self-supervision, covariance alignment, meta-knowledge diagnosis, adversarial multimodal depression detection, and pathology adaptation suppress site or identity shortcuts; cross-domain gains depend on preserving clinically meaningful variation.

topics.name: Diffusion model theory and controllability
topics.summary: Score-distribution analysis, spectral priors, angular latent watermarks, and interactive layer interventions study diffusion generation and control; frequency-aware calibration and exposed internal edits improve sampling reliability or user steering without removing distribution-shift risks.

topics.name: Affective computing and social interaction
topics.summary: Affective expression design, virtual-patient faces, empathetic commonsense, gaze relations, speech entrainment, and wearable olfactory sensing combine visual, vocal, physiological, and relational cues; coordinated signals better reflect context than isolated channels.

topics.name: Access-controlled database agents
topics.summary: Role-based text-to-SQL and production-fidelity database-agent benchmarks test permissions, persistent state, causal diagnosis, and recovery actions; operational correctness requires access-aware behavior beyond answer accuracy.

topics.name: Visual-inertial localization and odometry
topics.summary: Magnetic, visual-inertial, LiDAR-inertial, and sparse-view relocalization systems use repeated traversals, dual branches, embedded sensing, and geometry-aware synthesis; high-rate fusion improves continuity in agile, aliased, and low-texture environments.

topics.name: Molecular and biological sequence modeling
topics.summary: Molecular-glue generation, multiple-sequence alignment reasoning, spatial-transcriptomics neighborhood modeling, and protein representation learning use generative, factor-graph, graph-trajectory, and self-supervised methods; structural context improves biological inference when labels are limited.

topics.name: LLM evaluation, alignment, and reliability
topics.summary: Capability taxonomies, creativity judgments, dependency scales, counterfactual explanations, benchmark audits, influence-based data screening, quantization studies, adoption reports, and controlled reliability analyses show that labels, interfaces, and evaluation rules can dominate apparent model differences.

topics.name: Document OCR and visual text generation
topics.summary: Layout-aware token selection and joint visual-text generation and editing target bilingual documents and dense page structure; OCR-guided computation improves legibility and recognition while preserving small script details.

topics.name: Agent memory, skills, and long-horizon execution
topics.summary: Memory benchmarks, compact agents, deployment feedback, state-aware prompting, skill regression tests, self-play, program-state access, code-as-policy evolution, persistent workspaces, and coalition pricing study long-lived agents; externalized state helps recovery but can create regressions or resource conflicts.

topics.name: Data-driven optimization and engineering design
topics.summary: Surrogate experiments, inverse integer optimization, learned solver iterates, optimal stopping, UAV sizing, power-flow planning, and transformation sensitivity use explicit constraints or finite-complexity analysis; data-efficient search improves tractability when evaluations are costly or structured.

topics.name: Controllable human video generation and editing
topics.summary: Interaction plans, latent alignment, neural video decoding, identity-preserving restylization, and layered garment synthesis provide intermediate controls for human-centered video; structure improves motion, appearance, and occlusion handling over direct frame generation.

topics.name: Spatiotemporal representation learning and forecasting
topics.summary: Tensor variational models, homogeneity-aware transformers, regime-conditioned volatility models, and tropical-cyclone correction use shared trends plus subject- or regime-specific residuals; decomposing temporal variation improves forecasting under heterogeneous series.

topics.name: Clinical foundation models and radiological data
topics.summary: Multimodal EHR pretraining, radiological data harmonization, and latent analysis of weakly supervised mammography examine fusion, metadata, labels, and representation degradation; standardized inputs and mechanistic diagnostics clarify when extra modalities help.

topics.name: Efficient and sustainable recommender systems
topics.summary: Graph coarsening, label propagation, green-objective fine-tuning, representation injection, and evidence-preserving conversational retrieval optimize recommendation for speed, sustainability, personalization, and exact item support; quality gains are reported alongside resource or explanation tradeoffs.

topics.name: Low-resource multilingual translation and reasoning
topics.summary: Cross-lingual adapters, tokenizer merging, grammar-book synthesis, language-routed retrieval, and Bengali mathematical data address translation and reasoning where parallel examples are scarce; targeted resources improve transfer but expose language-specific scoring and coverage gaps.

topics.name: Causal inference and dynamical systems
topics.summary: Interventional score geometry, heteroscedastic reciprocal models, ergodic learning, cross-fitted causal forests, and causal differential equations extend inference beyond simple acyclic assumptions; uncertainty and structural constraints help distinguish dependence from actionable mechanism.

topics.name: Operational agentic AI
topics.summary: Self-calibrating edge allocation, enterprise operational case studies, and intrinsic-reward grounded search combine forecasting, evidence retrieval, and cost-aware action selection; reliable agents need bounded behavior and feedback that reflects changing resource or task conditions.

topics.name: Conversational educational assistants
topics.summary: Embodied tutoring, knowledge-grounded social robots, offline voice companions, and mobile coding education use personalization, struggle detection, and human studies; conversational support improves accessibility, but language and user-experience differences shape outcomes.

topics.name: Visual physical reasoning and monocular reconstruction
topics.summary: Multimodal temporal reversal, single-image material reasoning, structured motion bases, and microscope-pose reconstruction infer hidden physical state from sparse views; geometry and language priors improve measurement, event recovery, and dynamic scene consistency.

topics.name: Sampling structured probability distributions
topics.summary: Influence-based Boolean-product sampling and mirror-Langevin discretizations replace generic distributional assumptions with geometric conditions; the analyses provide convergence or finite-sample guarantees for structured non-Euclidean targets.

topics.name: Matrix optimization and spectral training dynamics
topics.summary: Graph-constrained correlation construction, directional curvature, spectral gradient shifts, polar singular-value routines, and affine update analysis study optimization geometry; shaping update directions or stopping rules controls conditioning and rare-class behavior.

topics.name: Quantum machine learning and circuit synthesis
topics.summary: Quantum query benchmarks, spectral data reuploading, transformer-based molecular-state preparation, and quantum-walk algorithms encode problem structure into circuits; frequency or Hamiltonian information reduces search and improves preparation efficiency.

topics.name: Differentiable rendering and inverse graphics
topics.summary: Deformable triangle primitives and inter-reflective Gaussian splats model visibility, geometry, and material transport for radiance fields; differentiable optimization supports flexible shapes, inverse rendering, and relighting under difficult views.

topics.name: Image and video compression
topics.summary: Generative video codecs and large multi-codec datasets study low-bitrate motion reconstruction and fine-grained artifact measurement; adaptive distillation improves perceptual detail while standardized comparisons expose rate-quality tradeoffs.

topics.name: Frequency-aware image restoration
topics.summary: Wavelet-guided diffusion reconstruction for electron microscopy and compact blind color denoising separate structure from detail; frequency-aware processing improves fidelity across noise levels without requiring large restoration models.

topics.name: EEG and biosignal interfaces
topics.summary: EEG waveform dictionaries, time-frequency clinical prediction, subject-level motor-imagery benchmarks, frozen-trunk personalization, and multimodal EMG control address user variability and low-data decoding; compact representations and cross-signal attention improve personalization and prosthetic interaction.

topics.name: Resource-aware distributed AI systems
topics.summary: Neural architecture search for federated edge devices, carbon-aware cloud routing, and coordinated on-device agent networking schedule computation under device, latency, energy, and media constraints; resource-aware placement lowers cost while preserving service quality.

topics.name: Physics-based computational imaging
topics.summary: Depth-aware underwater lookup tables, X-ray-to-CT correspondence, autonomous CT reconstruction, and scattering-based focal imaging combine physical image formation with learned reconstruction; explicit optics and geometry improve robustness beyond ideal acquisition conditions.

topics.name: LLM-assisted formal specification and validation
topics.summary: Constraint synthesis for hypergraph networks, invariant discovery, network-to-formal translation, and natural-language-to-SHACL benchmarks pair language models with validators or solvers; generated specifications become more trustworthy when semantics and satisfiability are checked externally.

topics.name: AI-assisted software engineering and interface design
topics.summary: Coding-agent trajectories, test-suite quality mining, buggy-code misguidance, assumption tracing, backlog generation, and generative UI audits examine AI-produced software artifacts; behavior-based checks and human review expose gaps between plausible rationale, coverage, and working implementations.

topics.name: Robust small-object insect vision
topics.summary: Mesh-free Gaussian perturbations and field-video detection address small pollinators under clutter, blur, occlusion, and scale imbalance; diverse appearance simulation and high-resolution features improve robustness more consistently than elaborate post-processing.
